newsitem.title: USA: Mecklermedia CFO named COO as well.
newsitem.headline: Mecklermedia CFO named COO as well.

text.p: Mecklermedia Corp said on Wednesday Chief Financial Officer Christopher Cardell has been promoted to executive vice president and chief operating officer, in addition to his CFO role.
Cardell will also offer strategic guidance on all aspects of the company, from day-to-day management to long-term growth strategies, the company said.
Mecklermedia provides Internet information through its various publications, like Internet World, Web Week and its Internet World trade shows and conferences, and its electronic daily newspaper.
